question.text: Under RBI's Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS), an Indian resident individual can remit overseas up to what amount per financial year?

explanation.text: The Logic: LRS limit is USD 250,000 per resident individual per financial year. The Trap: Lower amounts confuse with older caps; USD 1 million is the NRO repatriation cap. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent with X-A L1 Ch on regulatory constraints. Distributor's Pro-Tip: For PMS clients wanting global exposure, plan phased LRS remittances across family members.
